g.text: Signal order: two high-pass sections → gain → two low-pass sections → gain → output
For each active section, the non-inverting gain is K = 1 + Rfeedback / Rground. The input and feedback networks set its frequency response.
The RF resistors terminate the detector readout. Gain blocks represent the nominal linear transfer model; final scalar calibration is case-dependent.
